risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The auditors flagged the amount of revenue recognition as a key audit matter under SA 701, since software applications are developed for various clients at prices determined per contract. The auditors had to involve IT specialists to test the design and operating effectiveness of key IT controls over revenue recognition, indicating that revenue measurement depends materially on system-generated cost and revenue reports rather than simple invoicing.
- The audit response covered the IT environment in which the business systems operate, including access controls, program change controls, program development controls and IT operation controls, plus completeness and accuracy over cost and revenue reports generated by the system and application controls over allocation of resources and budgeting that prevent unauthorised recording or changes to costs. A failure in these controls would directly distort reported results.
- The auditors record that the Company is engaged in loyalty programmes for various banks and financial institutions. A loyalty business anchored on bank and financial-institution clients is exposed to those clients' procurement cycles, and to regulatory or budgetary changes in the financial sector, over which the Company has no control.
- The MD&A states the Company is engaged in a single segment, so there is no diversification buffer: a downturn in the core activity flows through to the whole business.
- The Company completed its IPO and was listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange only on 25.03.2026, six days before the financial year end, and converted from Novus Loyalty Private Limited. Full-year listed-entity governance, disclosure and internal-control discipline is therefore untested over a complete reporting cycle.
- The Directors' Report discloses foreign exchange earnings from sales alongside foreign exchange outgo, so a portion of revenue is earned in foreign currency and is exposed to rate movement. The report describes no hedging policy.
- The MD&A states the Company recognises people as its most valuable asset and that attrition has been managed below industry benchmarks. In a software and services business with no physical assets, delivery capacity is the workforce, so attrition is a structural rather than incidental risk.
- The MD&A states risk management is an integral part of the business strategy and that a dedicated team reviews compliance with risk policies, monitors risk tolerance limits and analyses risk exposure, but the report names no specific risk, no tolerance limit and no mitigation for any identified exposure. The internal control system is described as commensurate with the size, nature and operations of the Company.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continue building secure, reliable software for businesses as enterprises migrate from legacy hardware systems to cloud-based software
- Serve the shift of loyalty programmes to fully digital delivery through mobile apps and websites, with real-time tracking of customer preferences and personalised rewards
- Grow the loyalty programme business alongside the core software development activity, which the Company took up during the year under review
